| **Sushi Yoshitake** | Ginza | Michelin‑starred; offers a refined omakase experience with a focus on subtle flavors. |
| **Sushi Dai** | Tsukiji Outer Market | Renowned for fresh fish; long lines but worth the wait for a classic sushi experience. |
| **Sushi Daiwa** | Tsukiji Outer Market | Similar to Sushi Dai; known for high quality and reasonable prices. |
